strings.embed.donate.description:
Thank you for always using MoguTune!
The development of this bot and the operation of its server are supported by your contributions.

If you'd like, please consider supporting future development!
### - [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/Milkeyyy)

(Your support will be used for server maintenance costs and to maintain development motivation.)
